# Addis Ababa by Locals

> Addis Ababa by Locals is a locally owned tour operator in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. We run private and small-group city tours, day trips and custom itineraries with local guides who live here.

Powered by Sphere Tour & Travel. Licensed by Ministry of Tourism of Ethiopia. Save 15% when you book direct, with free cancellation up to 24 hours before the tour start time.

## Start here

- [Addis Ababa by Locals](https://addisabababylocals.com/): Locally owned Addis Ababa tour operator — start a trip enquiry with your dates and group size, or browse the tours.

## Book

- [All Tours](https://addisabababylocals.com/tours/): Every city tour, day trip and private itinerary with duration, group size, inclusions and price.
- [Book a Tour](https://addisabababylocals.com/book/): Pick your tour, date and number of guests, add pickup details and confirm — free cancellation up to 24 hours before the tour start time.
- [Custom Tour](https://addisabababylocals.com/custom-tour/): Request a tailor-made itinerary built around your dates, interests, group size and budget.
- [Local Guides](https://addisabababylocals.com/guides/): Tell us your interests, dates, group size and language, and we match you with the right guide.
- [Contact](https://addisabababylocals.com/contact/): WhatsApp, phone, email and office hours — we respond within 24 hours.

## Tours

- [Half-Day Addis Ababa by Locals](https://addisabababylocals.com/tours/half-day-addis-ababa-city-tour/) — 4 hours: National Museum, Merkato & Meskel Square.
- [Full-Day Addis Ababa by Locals](https://addisabababylocals.com/tours/full-day-addis-ababa-city-tour/) — 8–9 hours: Comprehensive City Highlights with Coffee Ceremony.
- [Addis Ababa Highlights Tour](https://addisabababylocals.com/tours/addis-ababa-highlights-tour/) — 6 hours: Best of the City in 6 Hours.
- [Debre Libanos & Portuguese Bridge Day Trip](https://addisabababylocals.com/tours/debre-libanos-portuguese-bridge/) — 8–9 hours: 13th-Century Monastery, Blue Nile Gorge & Gelada Baboons.
- [Tiya, Adadi Mariam & Melka Kunture UNESCO Day Trip](https://addisabababylocals.com/tours/tiya-adadi-mariam-melka-kunture/) — 9–10 hours: Ancient Stelae, Rock-Hewn Churches & Archaeological Treasures.
- [Menagesha Forest Day Trip](https://addisabababylocals.com/tours/menagesha-forest-day-trip/) — 8–9 hours: Highland Rainforest, Waterfalls & Endemic Wildlife.
- [Bishoftu Crater Lakes Day Trip](https://addisabababylocals.com/tours/bishoftu-crater-lakes/) — 8 hours: Five Stunning Crater Lakes in the Rift Valley.
- [Airport Layover Tour](https://addisabababylocals.com/tours/airport-layover-tour/) — 4–6 hours: 4–6 Hour Custom City Tour for Transit Passengers.
- [Private Group Tours](https://addisabababylocals.com/tours/private-group-tours/) — Flexible (1–3 days): Custom Itineraries for Families, Friends & Corporate Groups.

## Explore

- [Things to Do](https://addisabababylocals.com/things-to-do/): Experiences in Addis Ababa with durations and links to the matching tours.
- [Where to Stay](https://addisabababylocals.com/where-to-stay/): Neighbourhood guidance for Bole, Kazanchis, Piassa, Meskel Square and more.
- [Airport Transfers](https://addisabababylocals.com/airport-transfers/): Bole International Airport pickups and drop-offs to hotels across the city.
- [Car Hire](https://addisabababylocals.com/car-hire/): Car hire with a professional driver for city days and longer trips.
